detail.longDescription: What’s more, even though Cork’s code is hosted mainly on GitHub, we also have our own code repository & forum, so we’re double unaffected by these outages https:// code.rikidar.eu/PublishedSourc e/Cork https:// forum.rikidar.eu All releases are hosted on an on-prem server, so no outages there, either: https:// corkmac.app/releases.json And to top it off, all emails are hosted in Germany through Mailbox.org, so believe it or not, we can always send emails # macdev # programming # sysadmin # selfhosted # SelfHost # SelfHosting
